purpose: Every L4D2 file the mod reads at runtime, in one place. Nothing listed here is ever uploaded: each player's own L4D2 install supplies it.
notes: Candidate paths come from memory and a short web check; the Survivors' internal names (Coach, Gambler, Mechanic, Producer) were seen in public discussion of the demo files, but no full path here has been confirmed.

l4d2_ref.about: VPK path of the file, or the sound-script entry name, or a folder/glob for a sound group.

materials.about: For models: the VMT/VTF files named inside the MDL.

rows.l4d2_ref: models/survivors/survivor_coach.mdl
rows.companions: .vvd and .dx90.vtx, plus .ani / .phy if the MDL needs them (candidate)
rows.decoder: MdlReader + VvdReader + VtxReader; materials through VmtReader + VtfReader
rows.resolve_hint: Confirm the path by listing the VPK directory, then record the real one here.
rows.missing_behavior: disable whatever needs this model and log which file is missing; never swap in a stand-in
